summary: Colliers International Group Inc. filed a 6-K announcing a Normal Course Issuer Bid (NCIB) to repurchase up to 4,300,000 subordinate voting shares (~10% of public float) over twelve months starting May 15, 2026, at market price. Purchases will occur on TSX, alternative Canadian systems, or Nasdaq, with daily limits of 22,078 shares (barring block purchases). The board believes repurchases are an appropriate use of funds. BMO Nesbitt Burns is the designated broker; an automatic share purchase plan covers black-out periods. All shares bought will be cancelled. No purchases were made under the prior NCIB. This is an open-market buyback program, not a tender offer.
